concept: First-person mirror selfie outfit check showcasing embroidered lawn suit

scenes.visual: confident young woman standing in front of large full-length mirror in modern styled room, holding phone up to take mirror selfie, wearing green embroidered lawn suit, visible head-to-toe
scenes.background: modern minimalist bedroom with soft natural light, clean walls, wooden flooring
scenes.vo: Guys, is outfit check time! Dekho ye lawn suit kitna beautiful hai

scenes.visual: same woman turning to flattering three-quarter angle in mirror, phone still raised, showing side profile of the embroidered green suit
scenes.background: same modern bedroom with mirror, soft afternoon light filtering through
scenes.vo: Embroidery ka work dekho - itna detailed aur elegant lagta hai na

scenes.visual: closer waist-up framing of same woman in mirror showing intricate embroidered neckline and sleeves, phone visible in frame
scenes.background: mirror reflection with soft diffused lighting, blurred background
scenes.vo: Lawn fabric ki quality amazing hai - breathable aur comfortable feel

scenes.visual: same woman facing mirror with confident expression, full outfit visible, phone held up for selfie
scenes.background: stylish modern room with natural lighting, clean aesthetic
scenes.vo: Perfect hai summer ke liye - stylish aur classy look mil raha

scenes.visual: same woman looking directly at camera through mirror with bright smile, phone still raised, complete embroidered suit visible
scenes.background: bright modern interior with mirror, warm natural light
scenes.vo: Tum bhi try karo The Collection se - link check karo aur order karo abhi!

notes: First-person outfit check format with consistent woman throughout, showcasing embroidered lawn suit through natural mirror selfie progression. Each scene maintains phone-in-hand authenticity while highlighting different aspects of the garment.
